goal: A Python CLI tool that scans a specified directory for image files (PNG, JPG) and PDF files. It uses a local OCR library (like pytesseract) to extract text, then applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields. It outputs a structured CSV/JSON file and supports simple tax categorization rules. No external APIs or cloud sync.
acceptance_criteria: Module 'ocr_engine.py' exists and imports pytesseract/pillow to extract text from image files.
Module 'invoice_parser.py' applies regex rules to identify vendor, date, and amount fields from extracted text.
Module 'output_handler.py' uses pandas to output structured data to CSV/JSON files.
CLI entry point 'main.py' scans directory, processes files, and calls output handler.
